short_description: Zorvak style, white cranes in a marshy landscape with boats and a village under a red sky.

objects.relationship: scattered across the water and reeds
objects.shape_and_color: white bodies with black legs and red crowns on some; long curved necks
objects.appearance_details: four cranes visible; one flying low with wings spread, one standing in reeds with head lowered, one standing in reeds with head up, one flying low in the midground
objects.pose: flying, standing, head lowered, head up

objects.shape_and_color: long, narrow wooden boats, brown and tan
objects.appearance_details: three boats visible; one in the center with a yellow load, one to the right with figures, one further back
several small houses with thatched roofs clustered together

objects.shape_and_color: tall, thin trunks with dark green foliage
objects.appearance_details: a dense row of slender trees with small, rounded canopies

background_setting: A marshy river landscape with reeds in the foreground, a row of thin trees and a village with thatched roofs in the midground, and distant mountains under a red sky.

lighting.conditions: dusk or dawn, with a red sky

aesthetics.composition: layered landscape with foreground reeds, midground water and village, and background mountains
